DOJ confirms FBI Director Kash Patel's personal email was hacked
item.description:
📝 On their website, the Handala Hack Team boasted that Patel “will now find his name among the list of successfully hacked victims. In a press release, Patel threatened to “hunt” down the group, which Reuters reported “calls itself a group of pro-Palestinian vigilante hackers. Hackers claimed that their data grab included confidential information about Patel, but that could not be independently verified.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/03/doj-confirms-fbi-director-kash-patels-personal-email-was-hacked/
